register.labelZh: OPEN 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: open onto、open into 和 open off 能幫助你描述房間、大廳、花園和其他地方之間的連接。；open out 能幫助你描述山谷、道路、海岸或景色在眼前變得寬闊。；你可以用 open a map out 表示攤開地圖,也可以用 open a parcel up 或 open a case up 表示打開包裹或箱子。；open up 可以表示某人開始坦白談及憂慮、恐懼或其他個人感受。；open up 可以表示新的工作、名額、道路或可能性變得可供選擇。
register.summaryEn: Open onto, open into and open off help you describe the connection between rooms, halls, gardens and other places. Open out helps you describe a valley, road, coast or view spreading wide in front of you. You can open a map out, open a parcel up or open a case up when you need to see or use what is inside. Open up lets you say that someone begins to speak honestly about worries, fear or other personal feelings. Open up can show that new jobs, places, routes or possibilities have become available.
